In-flight Chain strip v1.0-strip

The same real autopilot flight (seed 7, Body Spark, Echo, Lift Guide, Resonant Harvest), recorded three times with a different strip look. Top-centre of each clip. Pick by code.

Back to the lab

Same rules in all three: one flash at a time (0.7 s), one pending flash per card, the strip fades after 3 s idle, no text to read in flight. A card's diamond or pip marks an Inscription-only slot. Try a variant in the game with ?strip=a|b|c on game.html. Made by scripts/variant-clips.mjs.
